svg.aria-label: Load tests at 50, 200, 500 and 1,000 users. Throughput rose from 220 to 866 turns per minute (491 at 500 users, a run before the fixes). Time to accept a message stayed flat: p50 122, 110, 110 and 115 ms; p95 318, 206, 225 and 325 ms. Turns completed: 250 of 250, 1,000 of 1,000, 2,497 of 2,500 and 3,000 of 3,000.
